text:
Alice: Quick kickoff — want to align on a combined developer content push: 1) OSS reference app launch post, 2) hands-on webinar, 3) benchmark narrative for routing leads. Goal: drive signups + PRs to the repo. Thoughts?

Jorge: love it. can we prioritize a tutorial path for the webinar that maps directly to the refapp repo so attendees can clone + run during Q&A? :thumbsup:()

Sam: agree. timeline? we should aim for a mid-May webinar to catch post-conference noise. need 2 weeks for blog + social drafts, 1 week for rehearsals.

Priya: inbound routing note — we'll want a dedicated HubSpot form for this campaign with a hidden field `campaign=dev-refapp-may23` so we can tag leads and auto-assign to devrel. Also add a checkbox for "interested in Dedicated/Private" so Sales gets the right qualification.

Devin: technical checklist for the refapp: make sure docker-compose has a cpu-only path, and a tiny dataset for the workshop. I'll open a PR to add `examples/minimal` and a README exercise.

Amanda: draft for launch post (first pass):

"Introducing redwood-inference/reference-starter — a lightweight reference app that shows how to run inference locally, deploy to Dedicated, and validate latency against our benchmarks. Comes with step-by-step tutorial and demo prompts."

Sam: nice. can we also bake in a short benchmark section (latency + cost numbers) and a small graph image? marketing needs a one-line hook for socials. something punchy like: "Ship LLM features faster — 3 steps to go from local prototype to production-grade inference."

Jorge: for the webinar agenda: 1) 10m intro + product positioning, 2) 25m live walkthrough of refapp (clone, run, tweak model), 3) 10m benchmarking demo showing batching & caching wins, 4) 15m Q&A + live troubleshooting.

Priya: registration flow: landing page -> HubSpot form -> tag leads -> trigger Slack notify to #sales-inbound. can we build an automation: if "interested in Dedicated" checked, assign to AE pool A; otherwise route to devrel nurture. I have automation templates.

Amanda: social post drafts (short):
- "New: reference-starter — get from prototype to production inference in under an hour. Join our webinar to watch it live. RSVP -> <https://events.redwood.com/dev-refapp>"
- "Benchmark snapshot: 3x token throughput with intelligent batching. See how in our refapp + live demo. Register: <https://events.redwood.com/dev-refapp>"

Devin: small code snippet to add to the README for the workshop so attendees can test latency locally:

```
# run a quick latency test
python tools/latency_test.py --model local-quant --tokens 128 --runs 10
```

Jorge: can someone on content own the benchmark narrative? we need to explain methodology (p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, instance types, batching settings). Also include a short explainer about fallbacks (model variants) so people understand reliability story.

Amanda: I'll own the benchmark writeup. will include a table of config vs results and a reproducible script in `bench/README.md`.

Sam: comms plan: launch blog + GitHub release Mon, webinar Wed, follow-up email with recording + pull request guide Fri. Priya, can growth run an email + retargeting sequence for attendees who didn't sign up for Dedicated?

Priya: yes. I'll set up a 3-email drip: thanks/recording, how-to tutorial, and Dedicated offer. Also create an audience in Ads for webinar registrants who visited pricing.

Alice: checklist / owners (quick):
- Refapp PR for examples/minimal — Devin
- Benchmark scripts & results — Amanda
- Blog + GH release notes — Amanda + Sam
- Webinar runbook (slides, slides deck, rehearsal slots) — Jorge + webinar-bot
- Landing page + HubSpot form + routing automation — Priya
- Social copy + assets (gif of demo, graph) — Sam

webinar-bot: Reminder: rehearsal slots available Tue 2pm & Thu 11am. Use `/rehearse add @Jorge @Amanda` to reserve.

Devin: I'll push the minimal example tonight and tag @Amanda. expect PR link by EOD.

Amanda: awesome — once I have the PR link I'll add the bench script and start draft of the blog. planning to include a small pull-req-style contributor guide for the repo.

Sam: social amplification: can we ask a couple of community partners to co-host or share? ping list: @open-source-forum, @llm-hackers. also prepare a short media one-pager for outreach.

Priya: inbound routing mapping (quick JSON mapping for devops to implement in the webhook):

```
{
  "form_id": "hs_dev_refapp_may23",
  "fields": {
    "email": "email",
    "name": "firstname",
    "company": "company",
    "interested_dedicated": "property_interested_dedicated"
  },
  "routing": {
    "interested_dedicated": "AE_POOL_A",
    "else": "DEVREL_NURTURE"
  }
}
```

Jorge: love the mapping. can engineering add a small webhook that posts to #sales-inbound with a one-line summary + link to HubSpot lead? that'll reduce slack noise.

Priya: yes — I'll set the webhook to only notify for leads with company size > 50 or `interested_dedicated=true` so we avoid spamming.

Alice: next steps: Amanda/Sam produce first drafts by Thu EOD. Devin opens PR tonight. Priya builds form + automation by Fri. We'll reconvene in this thread for final signoff before publishing. thanks all :raised_hands:()

Devin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/reference-starter/pull/42 — includes `examples/minimal` and `tools/latency_test.py`.

Amanda: got the PR and started bench script. will post draft blog link here when ready.

Sam: adding social assets to figma board now -> <https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/refapp-assets>

webinar-bot: Event created: "Refapp Live Workshop" — Wed May 17 10:00 PDT. Registration: <https://events.redwood.com/dev-refapp>.

Alice: perfect. I'll check in Friday for status.

Jorge: +1. excited to show the batching demo.

Amanda: draft blog link: https://docs.google.com/draft/refapp-launch-draft — posting comments by EOD.

Priya: automation created in HS: `hs_workflow_197` — live. I'll share tracking IDs later.

Alice: thanks team — this is a solid plan.
